hero.title: Multilingual web design for businesses in Munich
hero.lede: More customers, more enquiries, a professional presence — and found on Google. Modern websites for small and international businesses, in German, English, Dari and Farsi.

1.d: A modern, mobile-friendly business website — design, build, text layout and handover. You get the files, not just a login.

2.d: German, English, Dari and Farsi on one site — with correct right-to-left typesetting, the right fonts, and a language switch that actually works.

3.d: One page with one job: turning visitors into conversations. Clear message, one call to action, nothing competing for attention.

4.d: Refresh an existing site, update content, fix what's broken. One-off or ongoing — your choice.

proc.title: From first call to live.
proc.lede: Four steps, in this order. You always know what we're working on.

1.d: Not mirrored graphics — proper reading direction in navigation, forms and tables.

2.d: Persian script needs its own spacing and line height. Default fonts make it hard to read.

3.d: Explain your business in German, English, Dari or Farsi — not whichever language is left over.

lng.title: Multilingual isn't an add-on. It's the reason.
lng.lede: Most agencies translate the text and call it multilingual. A site in Dari or Farsi runs right to left — layout, numbers, forms, navigation. We build that properly, because we work in these languages ourselves.

about.title: About Peivando
about.lede: We help small and international businesses in Germany win customers online.
about.p1: Peivando builds websites that work in German, English, Dari and Farsi — technically clean, mobile, with a form and WhatsApp, and personal support.
about.p2: We focus on businesses in and around Munich whose customers speak more than one language: restaurants, trades, clinics, retail and local services.

1.a: Starter from €399 (one page), Business from €899 (up to 5 pages), Multilingual from €1,290 (German plus one more language, including RTL). The free first conversation clarifies the real scope.

2.q: Which languages can the site use?
2.a: German, English, Dari and Farsi — including right-to-left. Further languages on request.

3.a: A one-page site often takes a few weeks once copy and images are ready. Multi-page and multilingual sites take longer. We give a timeline before we start.

4.q: I don't have text or photos yet.
4.a: That's fine. We map the pages with you and say clearly what you need to provide. Placeholders get replaced when the material arrives.

5.q: Are the projects real client sites?
5.a: Work labelled “Concept project” is a design study, not a live reference. We only publish real testimonials when we have them.

6.a: Small and international businesses in Germany — especially when your customers speak German, English, Dari or Farsi.

con.title: Tell us what you have in mind.
con.lede: A few details on need, pages, languages and budget are enough. We reply within 24 hours — in German, English, Dari or Farsi.
